metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Gordon Wrongturn
records.biography_en: Gordon Wrongturn booked a place with The All Inclusive Incident. The map was like this when I got it. The incident report lists upside-down folded resort map as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: The map was like this when I got it.

records.name: Pam Poolclaim
records.biography_en: Pam Poolclaim booked a place with The All Inclusive Incident. That lounger is occupied by my towel. The incident report lists striped towel wrapped around a miniature folding lounger as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: That lounger is occupied by my towel.

records.name: Clive Buffetsprint
records.biography_en: Clive Buffetsprint booked a place with The All Inclusive Incident. I'm getting these for the table. The incident report lists precarious plate of three tiny desserts as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: I'm getting these for the table.

records.name: Dex Doubletake
records.biography_en: Dex Doubletake booked a place with The All Inclusive Incident. Do it again. I missed the collapse. The incident report lists chunky compact camera and dangling lens cap as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Do it again. I missed the collapse.

records.name: Nora Wristband
records.biography_en: Nora Wristband booked a place with The All Inclusive Incident. Stay where I can count you. The incident report lists small raised paddle with one blank colored circle and coil of wristbands as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: Stay where I can count you.

records.name: Ian Extras
records.biography_en: Ian Extras booked a place with The All Inclusive Incident. How is shade an optional extra? The incident report lists absurdly long curled blank receipt held close as the only personal effect accounted for.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: How is shade an optional extra?
